# Crustdata

CrustData is an AI-powered data intelligence platform that provides real-time company and people data via APIs and webhooks, empowering B2B sales teams, AI SDRs, and investors to act on live signals

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/crustdata/.

## Actions

- **Enrich person screener** (read-only): The screener person enrich endpoint enriches person data by providing additional information based on the given query.
- **Screener company information** (read-only): The getcompanyscreener endpoint allows users to search and filter companies based on various criteria such as headcount, growth rate,…
- **Fetch headcount by facet timeseries** (read-only): Retrieves headcount data as a timeseries with faceted analysis capabilities.
- **Fetch investor portfolio data** (read-only): Retrieves comprehensive investor portfolio data from the data lab section of the crustdata api.
- **Filter decision makers data** (read-only): Filters and retrieves decision maker data from the crustdata b2b saas integration platform based on complex criteria.
- **Post funding milestone timeseries data** (read-only): The fundingmilestonetimeseries endpoint retrieves time-series data related to funding milestones for companies.
- **Post headcount timeseries data** (read-only): Retrieves filtered and sorted headcount timeseries data from the crustdata data lab.
- **Post job listings table data** (read-only): This endpoint retrieves filtered and sorted job listings data for specified company tickers from a chosen dataset in the crustdata platform.
- **Post web traffic data** (read-only): Retrieves filtered and sorted web traffic data from the crustdata platform.
- **Retrieve linkedin posts** (read-only): Retrieves linkedin posts for a specified company using crustdata's screener functionality.
- **Screen metrics and filter conditions** (read-only): The screendata endpoint enables advanced data screening and filtering on the crustdata platform.
- **Search companies with filters** (read-only): The companysearch endpoint enables users to search and filter companies using the crustdata api.
- **Search for job id in screener** (read-only): The screener person search endpoint allows users to search for persons associated with a specific job id within the crustdata b2b saas…
- **Search linkedin posts by keyword** (read-only): This endpoint enables searching for linkedin posts using a specific keyword.
